analyst.summary: TARC is a Delhi-NCR luxury residential developer that began handing over units in its TARC Tripundra project this year, which drove a large jump in reported revenue and a swing to a small full-year profit after a loss the year before. Real-estate revenue of this kind is recognized only when units are completed and handed over, so it arrives in large, uneven steps rather than smoothly -- and even in this profitable year, the company's core operating earnings were not enough to cover its interest costs, which argues for caution despite the improved headline numbers.
